title: Passing Yards Speed Step 6 Full Analysis Latency
objective: Reduce the remaining selected-QB full-analysis readiness latency after Step 5 solved payload size. First classify whether the remaining wait is server pipeline or browser/transport/DOM time.

current_failure_epoch.patch: Replace heredocs with deterministic printf lists; no product/runtime/model/data/math changes.
